title: Music Genres
description: Popular music genres with their decade and region of origin and a short description.

results.name: Blues
results.description: African American folk music built on the twelve-bar form and blue notes, ancestral to jazz and rock.

results.name: Jazz
results.description: Improvisation-driven genre blending blues, ragtime, and swing rhythms.

results.name: Ragtime
results.description: Syncopated piano style that predated jazz, popularized by Scott Joplin.

results.name: Gospel
results.description: Christian devotional music rooted in African American church traditions.

results.name: Country
results.description: Rural American genre drawing on folk ballads, string bands, and honky-tonk.

results.name: Swing
results.description: Big-band jazz style built for dancing with a strong rhythmic groove.

results.name: Bluegrass
results.description: Acoustic string-band offshoot of country featuring fast banjo and fiddle.

results.name: Rhythm and Blues
results.description: African American popular music combining blues, jazz, and gospel that shaped rock and soul.

results.name: Rock and Roll
results.description: Backbeat-driven fusion of rhythm and blues and country that launched rock music.

results.name: Soul
results.description: Emotive fusion of gospel and rhythm and blues centered on expressive vocals.

results.name: Ska
results.description: Upbeat Jamaican genre with offbeat guitar chords that preceded reggae.

results.name: Surf Rock
results.description: Reverb-heavy instrumental rock associated with surfing culture.

results.name: Motown
results.description: Polished soul-pop sound developed by Detroit's Motown Records label.

results.name: Psychedelic Rock
results.description: Experimental rock evoking drug-influenced experiences with distortion and studio effects.

results.name: Funk
results.description: Rhythmic, groove-based genre emphasizing bass and syncopated drums.

results.name: Reggae
results.description: Jamaican genre with offbeat rhythms and socially conscious lyrics.

results.name: Folk Rock
results.description: Fusion of folk songwriting with rock instrumentation and amplification.

results.name: Heavy Metal
results.description: Loud, aggressive rock built on distorted guitars, power, and volume.

results.name: Progressive Rock
results.description: Ambitious rock incorporating extended forms and classical or jazz complexity.

results.name: Punk Rock
results.description: Fast, stripped-down, anti-establishment rock with a do-it-yourself ethos.

results.name: Disco
results.description: Dance-floor genre with a steady four-on-the-floor beat and lush production.

results.name: Hip Hop
results.description: Culture and genre built on rapping over beats, sampling, and DJing.

results.name: New Wave
results.description: Pop-leaning offshoot of punk incorporating synthesizers and quirky style.

results.name: Synth-pop
results.description: Pop music in which the synthesizer is the dominant instrument.

results.name: House
results.description: Repetitive four-on-the-floor electronic dance music born in Chicago clubs.

results.name: Techno
results.description: Electronic dance genre built on machine rhythms and futuristic textures.

results.name: Thrash Metal
results.description: Fast, aggressive metal subgenre with rapid riffing and intense drumming.

results.name: Grunge
results.description: Distorted, angst-ridden fusion of punk and heavy metal from the Pacific Northwest.

results.name: Alternative Rock
results.description: Broad category of rock existing outside the commercial mainstream.

results.name: Grime
results.description: Fast, bass-heavy electronic genre combining UK garage and hip hop.

results.name: Dubstep
results.description: Electronic genre defined by sub-bass, sparse rhythms, and heavy drops.

results.name: Emo
results.description: Emotionally expressive offshoot of hardcore punk with confessional lyrics.

results.name: Trap
results.description: Hip hop subgenre marked by rapid hi-hats, heavy 808 bass, and dark themes.

results.name: K-pop
results.description: South Korean pop music known for polished production and choreographed groups.

results.name: Afrobeats
results.description: Contemporary West African pop blending highlife, hip hop, and dancehall.

results.name: Classical
results.description: Formal Western art music tradition spanning centuries of composed works.
